text:
david_customer_ops: Hey team — our prod svc reported a sudden p99 jump from ~420ms to ~2.8s since the 03:00 deploy. Multiple customers seeing timeouts and a couple 5xxs. No config changes on our side. Can you triage?

alice_support: Sorry you're hitting this — I'm escalating to runtime + oncall. Can you paste a couple request IDs?

david_customer_ops: req: a1b2c3, req: d4e5f6. Logs show repeated GC-ish stalls + OOM-ish messages on the worker node: `gpu mem alloc failed` and `kv cache growth`.

alice_support: Copying @ben_runtime @cara_sre_oncall — markers look like memory pressure on GPU and KV bloat.

ben_runtime: Looking now. Initial glance at telemetry: GPU total mem usage steady but fragmented; available allocatable chunks low. KV cache size has a slow unbounded growth for tenant X. p95 smaller but p99 huge — consistent with long alloc retries + fallback pacing.

cara_sre_oncall: Any recent autoscaler/placement changes? @fiona_infra?

fiona_infra: No placement changes. One host had a software update last night but no kernel or driver update. We have extra capacity in the region if we want to move traffic.

eric_allocator: Can you dump allocator stats from the affected pod? Command: `curl -s http://localhost:6060/debug/allocstats` — look for slab usage, free runs, and `arena_fragmentation` fields.

ben_runtime: Pasting excerpt: 
```
arena_count: 4
total_alloc: 41GB
total_free: 2.1GB
arena_fragmentation: 0.68
kv_cache_entries: 1.9M (was 120k pre-deploy)
last_compact_ts: 2027-11-12T02:58:10Z
```
This looks like KV growth + high fragmentation.

david_customer_ops: The customer reports a load spike ~03:05 but not huge — normal traffic, not replay. They saw backend 504s.

alice_support: Ok this reads like KV entries not being evicted and allocator failing to find contiguous GPU blocks, so alloc retries slow down token loops -> p99.

ben_runtime: Short term mitigation — reduce rt batch size for the model route for the tenant to force smaller transient allocations and reduce KV retention: `route-config: max_batch_tokens: 512 -> 256` and set `kv.max_entries_per_tenant: 200k` (soft cap). Can push immediately as a config override. Would reduce throughput but improve latency.

eric_allocator: Also can trigger a manual compaction on the node: `POST /internal/alloc/compact?force=true` — this will try arena defrag and slab compaction. It may spike short CPU but should free contiguous chunks.

cara_sre_oncall: Propose sequence: 1) apply soft kv cap for tenant X 2) lower max_batch_tokens 3) trigger compaction 4) watch p95/p99 and KV metrics 5) if not improved, fail traffic to warm nodes or rollback deploy. Agreed?

fiona_infra: We can also move 10% of traffic to a standby pool with fresh allocators to avoid cross-tenant contamination. If you want I can kick that.

david_customer_ops: Please do mitigations now, customers are impacted.

alice_support: I'm patching route config (soft kv cap + batch tokens) now, will confirm when done.

deploy-bot: patch applied: route-config/tenant-X: max_batch_tokens=256, kv.max_entries_per_tenant=200000 by alice_support at 4987654334

ben_runtime: Patch received. Also toggled `evict.on_high_water=true` for tenant X. Monitoring...

eric_allocator: Kicking compaction: `POST http://node-7:6060/internal/alloc/compact?force=true` -> 202 Accepted.

ben_runtime: Early signs: kv_cache_entries peaked and is stabilizing. Arena fragmentation dropped from 0.68 -> 0.44 in 90s. p99 trending down from 2.8s -> 560ms.

cara_sre_oncall: Nice. Keep watch 30m. If p99 still >750ms, schedule rollback.

david_customer_ops: Customer confirms reduced timeouts, thanks.

eric_allocator: Follow-ups: we should add an auto-eviction soft-cap per tenant and background compaction heuristics (trigger when arena_frag > 0.5 and kv_growth_rate > 10k/min). Filing design ticket.

fiona_infra: Also propose a rolling restart of affected worker(s) during low traffic window to reclaim fragmented GPU memory long-term.

ben_runtime: I'll open a runbook patch with these steps and add a metric alert for `arena_fragmentation > 0.5` AND `p99_latency > 1s` to auto-pager.

alice_support: Logging action items: 1) route patch applied (done) 2) compaction run (done) 3) monitor 30m (in progress) 4) infra will prepare rolling restart (fiona) 5) allocator + runtime: ticket for auto-evict/compaction heuristics.

david_customer_ops: Appreciate the quick response. Please loop me in if you need customer-side repro or traces.

cara_sre_oncall: Marking this as mitigated for now. Reopening if p99 regresses. :white_check_mark:

ben_runtime: Follow-up note: root cause appears to be a change in model caching behavior in the 03:00 deploy that increased KV retention for certain prompt patterns; combined with steady long-lived sessions it caused cross-tenant KV growth -> allocator fragmentation. We'll include a fix to keep KV TTLs per-invocation in the next patch.

eric_allocator: Filed ticket INFRA-7421: "auto-compaction + tenant soft-eviction heuristics" with proposed thresholds and an initial estimate.

alice_support: Closing customer loop now. Thanks all. :pray:
